name: Banff + Lake Louise Bookable Rockies Loop

dates.why: Aug 31-Sep 13 keeps the route in early September, starts with an easy Calgary arrival, and preserves a low-backtracking Calgary → Canmore → Lake Louise/Yoho → Jasper → Lake Louise return shape.

exchangeRateNote: Foreign-currency items use planning conversions and must be re-priced before booking.
positioning: Budget-rebalanced Canadian Rockies loop: condo/lodge bases carry the trip, with Fairmont and Post Hotel called out as upgrade options rather than the default.
routeLabel: Calgary → Canmore → Lake Louise → Jasper → Lake Louise
routeRationale: The route is ordered as Calgary → Canmore → Lake Louise → Jasper → Lake Louise to reduce backtracking and keep the biggest transfers between lodging bases.
Each base lasts 2-4 nights so the baby has repeated sleep environments instead of daily hotel churn.
High-impact sights are paired with nearby backup options so weather does not break the trip.
The Ryan Shirley/video inspiration is used for idea generation, then validated with official tourism, park, hotel, airline, and activity sources.

budget.note: Reworked under target by using Canmore and practical Lake Louise/Jasper lodging as the default. Fairmont/Post remain upgrade choices.

recommended.label: Recommended Delta/WestJet nonstop codeshare
recommended.cabin: Main Cabin / WestJet economy planning snapshot
recommended.infantNote: Canada infant-in-lap fees/taxes should be modest, but add the infant during Delta/WestJet booking.
recommended.budgetNote: Planning snapshot uses the Delta-marketed WestJet ATL-YYC nonstop pattern; re-price Aug 31-Sep 13 in Delta/WestJet checkout.

alternates.summary: Re-price on Delta with flexible dates and compare points value before booking.

bases.name: Calgary arrival night
bases.hotel: Calgary Airport Marriott or Applause Hotel
bases.why: Avoids a late mountain drive after flying with the baby.

bases.name: Canmore condo base
bases.hotel: Blackstone Mountain Lodge / Canmore condo alternative
bases.why: Kitchen, laundry, and lower rates make Banff days easier with a one-year-old.

bases.name: Lake Louise/Golden practical base
bases.hotel: Lake Louise Inn or Golden lodge base
bases.why: Keeps Moraine, Lake Louise, and Yoho accessible without Post/Fairmont every night.

bases.hotel: Pyramid Lake Lodge / Jasper Inn style base
bases.why: Still gives Jasper lakes and wildlife, but at a saner target rate.

bases.why: Returns south for the flight and gives one more lake day.
